question: When a native semantic effect succeeds but its response is lost before any success certificate is written, can a scheduled-Chat recurrence resume exactly once without replaying the effect?

neuroscience_mechanism.name: corollary-discharge comparator

public_sources.title: Global error signal guides local optimization in mismatch calculation
public_sources.source_claim_used: Corollary discharge is an internal signal about expected sensory consequences of self-generated actions and supports mismatch computation between prediction and sensory input.

public_sources.title: A primer on corollary discharges: neural signals that distinguish ‘Self’ from ‘World’
public_sources.source_claim_used: Corollary discharge supplies an internal prediction of the consequences of one's own action, enabling self-generated outcomes to be distinguished from external events.

neuroscience_mechanism.transfer: Persist an intent/efference-copy record before the native action. After an ambiguous response, compare that intended deterministic effect identity and payload against queryable durable reafferent state before deciding to replay. Matching observed effect means repair the certificate/pointer only; mismatch or absence means the effect may still need execution.

symbolic_probe.scope: serialized single-writer recurrence; one intent I21; deterministic effect_id e21; queryable native target; certificate C21 not yet created; role-local pointer P20
fault_cut: native target durably records exact effect_id/payload and semantic_effect_count becomes 1

policy_naive_replay.resume_observation: I21 exists; C21 absent; P20 unchanged
policy_naive_replay.action: replay E21 because certificate is absent

policy_corollary_query_before_replay.resume_observation: I21 exists; C21 absent; P20 unchanged
action: query native target for deterministic effect_id=e21
verify exact payload/hash h21 matches the persisted intent
if exact match exists, do not replay E21

histories_without_queryable_native_ident: H0: I21 exists, E21 never applied, response path ended before effect, C21 absent, P20
H1: I21 exists, E21 applied once, success response lost, C21 absent, P20
indistinguishability_boundary.required_actions_conflict: H0 requires executing E21; H1 requires not executing E21 to preserve exactly-once semantics.
indistinguishability_boundary.result: No deterministic recurrence rule using only I/C/P can guarantee both progress in H0 and exactly-once semantics in H1. A queryable deterministic native effect identity, a target-side idempotency key, or an atomic effect+certificate primitive is therefore a necessary interface capability for this cut; its absence is an unresolved Chat-native child problem rather than a passing mechanism.

probe_result: PASS only when the native target exposes durable deterministic effect identity/payload query (or equivalent target-side idempotency). Under that capability, intent/efference-copy plus reafferent query prevents duplicate replay after an ambiguous successful native effect before certificate creation. FAIL as a general exactly-once claim when that capability is absent, because applied and unapplied histories are recurrence-indistinguishable but require opposite actions.
mechanism_revision: Extend the previous intent-bound certificate rule one cut earlier: persist intent before action, assign deterministic effect identity, and require query-before-replay. Certificate absence alone is never evidence that the native effect did not happen.
tested_scope: one symbolic serialized single-writer cut with exact queryable native effect identity and payload equality; no concurrent writers; no native-target corruption; no nondeterministic effect identity; no distributed consensus claim

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: role-local checkpoint/certificate/pointer persistence only; no hosted compute and no repository API volume used as computation
mechanism_assessment.missing_capability_child_if_target_not_q: native effect destination must expose deterministic idempotency/query semantics or an atomic effect+certificate primitive; absent that, exactly-once continuation at this cut remains unresolved

conflict_check: Semantic inputs were limited to frozen sanitized root/config, own neuroscience LATEST/preflight, and two public neuroscience sources. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, scheduler, protected-primary, hosted-compute, finite-credit, paid, or manual-user execution semantics were used.
exact_next_action: On the next valid invocation, execute one target-side idempotency falsification probe: keep deterministic intent/effect_id but make the target query return stale/partial/ambiguous evidence. Compare strict exact-payload equality plus generation/nonce fencing against permissive existence-only recovery; require no false skip and no duplicate replay. If freshness/identity cannot be certified from Chat-native observable state, record that exact capability gap as the next unresolved child.
